Great place to start — it’s very simple.
Basic setup:
Put a little moisture on the tragus (the small bump on your ear).
Clip the earpiece on your left ear, with the cable going over and behind your ear.
Turn on your Nurosym.
Slowly increase the level until you feel a light tingling sensation. 
How to use it
You can sit, relax, or do normal activities while using it.
Typical use is 30–60 minutes per day, often in the morning or split between morning and evening.
The tingling sensation is normal and means the signal is active. Keep the level comfortable — it shouldn’t feel painful. 
If you have any specific health conditions or are taking prescription medications, it’s best to speak with our clinical team before starting.
